description: This file defines the 'Bug' class for the SuiteCRM project, extending SugarBean. It manages bug report data, including fields, relationships, query creation, and display logic within the CRM system.

classes.name: Bug
classes.description: A class representing bugs within the SuiteCRM system, including properties for bug attributes, relationships, and methods for data handling, queries, and display.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Bug object, setting up custom fields and mapping field definitions.

methods.name: get_summary_text
methods.description: Returns the name of the bug for summary display.

methods.name: create_list_query
methods.description: Constructs an SQL query to list bugs with optional ordering and filtering.

methods.name: create_export_query
methods.description: Builds an SQL query to export bug data with related information.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Fills in extra list view fields, such as assigned user name.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_detail_fields
methods.description: Populates additional detail view fields, such as release names.

methods.name: set_release
methods.description: Sets the release name based on the 'found_in_release' ID.

methods.name: set_fixed_in_release
methods.description: Sets the fixed in release name based on the 'fixed_in_release' ID.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data array for list view display, including localized labels and field values.

methods.name: build_generic_where_clause
methods.description: Builds a search condition for bug name or number based on a query string.

methods.name: set_notification_body
methods.description: Populates an email template with bug details for notifications.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates the interfaces implemented by the Bug bean, such as ACL.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the bug record, with optional notification.
